caption: The drawing consists of a repeating pattern featuring oval medallions that contain a black-and-white portrait of a man with white hair, wearing formal clothing. The medallions are vertically and horizontally aligned across the page. Interspersed between the medallions are red shield-shaped crests, each containing the word "PEACE" in white upper-case letters, along with an illustration of a bird, which appears to be an eagle, above the text. The entire pattern is overlaid on a light beige or off-white background with a subtle design of interlacing leafy branches in black. The composition is highly regular and symmetrical, with consistent spacing between the medallions and crests, creating a uniform, wallpaper-like effect.
title: Chintz with Portraits of George Washington
